import { test, expect } from '../../src/fixtures/playwright-fixtures';

test.describe('home page rooms', () => {
  test('shows at least one bookable room', async ({ homePage }) => {
    await homePage.open();
    await homePage.assertLoaded();
    await expect(homePage.roomCards.first()).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('book buttons are present', async ({ homePage }) => {
    await homePage.open();
    // GUESS: assuming book links render with the room cards
    expect(await homePage.bookRoomButtons.count()).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});
